senses.gloss: (with על, or ב־) to lean on; to trust; to be safe.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:8">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 8</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 27:40">Targ. Y. I Gen. XXVII, 40</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:6">Targ. Job XII, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ <he>רְחִיצַיָּא אנן</he> we are sure (cmp. <he>מובטח</he>, v. <cite ref="B00498"><he>בָּטַח</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:13">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>גברא דרחיצנא עליה וכ׳</he> the man in whom I trusted lifted up his club &c.; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 18:19">Targ. II Kings XVIII, 19</cite>, sq.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 25:2">Targ. Ps. XXV, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 36:8">Ib. XXXVI, 8</cite> Ms. (v. <cite ref="T00349"><he>רוּחְצָן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 49:4">Targ. Jer. XLIX, 4</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:6">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>דמודי … דמִתְרְחִיץ עליהון וכ׳</he> he who assents to them (pretends to share their errors) falls into their hand; he who confides in them,—what is his is theirs. Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵇ <he>לא תִתְרְחֵץ על צלותי</he> rely not on my prayer.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:2">Cant. R. to VII, 2</cite> <he>בגין דאִיתְרְחִיצוּ ביה</he> because they trusted in him; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 36:15">Targ. Is. XXXVI, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 18:30">Targ. II Kings XVIII, 30</cite>.
